0: City of Santa Claus, Georgia Ordinance (Voter Registration Qualifications) The Council of the City of Santa Claus hereby ordains that anyone allowed to register to vote in City elections shall first meet all of the following requirements. 1. Bonafide resident of City for three (3) months. 2. Must be eligible to vote in County, State and Federal elections. 3. Age eighteen (18) as of day of election. 4. Appears in person at City Hall to register no later than ten (10) days prior to election date. Information required upon registration. 1. Acceptable identification 2. Proof of age 3. Home address; not RFD or P.O. box number 4. Legal mailing address 5. Date established residence in City No one shall be permitted to register to vote until all requirements have been met. This ordinance supersedes any, and all, prior ordinances, if such exist, pertaining to voter registration qualifications.
